question:
**Direction: Select the correct spelling for the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**

Education plays a crucal role in breaking the cycle of poverty and child labour.
solution:
The correct answer is "crucial."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word "crucal" is misspelt.
 
• The correctly spelt word is **"Crucial."**
 
• The word "crucial" means extremely important. (अत्‍यधिक महत्वपूर्ण, निर्णायक)
 
 
• Example:* Early diagnosis of the illness is **crucial**__ for successful treatment.*
 
 
 
• Rest of the words are spelled correctly in the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.
